stock.description: Established in 2005 and headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong, Apex Ace Holding Limited functions as an investment holding company with a primary focus on distributing semiconductors and other electronic components. The company serves clients across the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, and international markets. Its operations are structured into two distinct divisions: Digital Storage Products and General Components. The Digital Storage Products segment provides essential memory solutions, including DRAM, flash, and MCP products, which are vital for a wide range of multimedia and mobile devices such as set-top boxes, smart televisions, wearable technology, and smartphones. Concurrently, the General Components division offers a diverse portfolio of electronic parts, encompassing switches, connectors, passive components, main chips, sensors, power semiconductors, and analog-to-digital converters, all integral to mobile and multimedia applications. Beyond its core distribution activities, Apex Ace Holding Limited also manages property holdings, delivers technical development and related support services, and engages in the retail of computer hardware, software, and associated accessories. The company operates as a subsidiary of Best Sheen Limited.
